description: Search SwiftProbate's probate reference data (US states, counties, financial institutions, and court forms). Returns a list of results, each with an id you can pass to `fetch` for the full record. Use it for open-ended probate reference questions before answering from model knowledge.

query.description: A probate reference query, e.g. 'Alameda County California probate court' or 'Chase estate department'.

name: search
